To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the feasible generalized double k-estimator with a constant value of k, denoted by k-estimator, has a smaller risk than the feasible double k-estimators, (ii) the feasible generalized 0.5-estimators have the smallest risk among the feasible double k-class estimations, and (iii) the feasible generalized k-estimators have a risk which is close to that of the feasible generalized 1-estimators.

the risk associated with the feasible generalized double k class estimators under LINEX loss is less than that of the feasible generalized double M class estimators and feasible double k class estimator under LINEX loss.

(a) the double k-class estimator is more efficient than the k-class estimator; (b) the feasible generalized double k class estimator is more efficient that the double k class estimator; and (c) the double k class estimators are more efficient under the LINEX than under the quadratic loss function.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a class of estimators that are robust against non-spherical errors in linear regression model.
the performance of the feasible double k-class estimator of the family of generalized double k-class estimator under the LINEX-loss function.
the performance of double k-class estimator for coefficients in a linear regression models with nonspherical disturbances.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the estimators in the feasible generalized double k class family perform well under asymmetric loss.
the estimators of this family are generally more efficient than those of the k-class estimators and are also generally more efficient than the feasible double k-class estimator of Kariya (1993).

the feasible generalized double k-estimators perform better than the feasible k-class estimators and the feasible generalized k-class estimators, in terms of the risk under the LINEX asymmetric loss function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the feasible generalized double k-estimator is the best estimator in terms of the risk for the estimators of interest in the family of generalized double k-class estimator.

, under the LINEX asymmetric loss function, the generalized double k-class estimator performs best among the feasible double k-class estimatores, while the double k-class estimator is best among the infeasible double k-class estimatos.
the double k-class estimates are more robust against the non-spherical errors than the ordinary least squares estimates.

the risk of the feasible generalized double k- class estimators is less than that of the generalized double k-class estimator.
the feasible double k-class estimator is a robust and competitive estimator in the family of estimators.
